name: Default starter rule set (Israel)
description: Starter design rules shipped with the plugin (D3). Copy this file and edit values for an office or municipality. Values marked verified=true were confirmed by the owner (D10, 2026-10-23); values added later with verified=false still need checking.

rules.label: Accessible route: maximum slope along the path
rules.source: SI 1918 part 1 (accessible route; steeper than this is a ramp); confirmed by owner 2026-10-23 (D10)

rules.label: Accessible route: maximum cross fall
rules.source: SI 1918 part 1 (accessible route cross slope); confirmed by owner 2026-10-23 (D10)

rules.label: Paved plaza: minimum drainage fall
rules.source: Generic good practice for unit paving drainage (editable); confirmed by owner 2026-10-23 (D10)

rules.label: Paved plaza: maximum fall (plaza is part of the accessible route)
rules.source: SI 1918 part 1 (level areas on the accessible route); confirmed by owner 2026-10-23 (D10)

rules.label: Lawn: minimum fall so it drains
rules.source: Generic good practice (editable); confirmed by owner 2026-10-23 (D10)

rules.label: Lawn: maximum slope for mowing (1:4)
rules.source: Generic good practice (editable); confirmed by owner 2026-10-23 (D10)

rules.label: Planting bed: maximum slope before it needs erosion control (1:3)
rules.source: Generic good practice (editable); confirmed by owner 2026-10-23 (D10)
